WiFi QR Code Generator

QR code that joins WiFi networks on scan.

Your SSID and password are encoded in the QR image itself — anyone who scans it can join the network.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your WiFi network name (SSID).
  2. Enter the password and pick the encryption type.
  3. Tick “Hidden SSID” only if your network does not broadcast its name.
  4. Click Generate, then download the QR code as a PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does a WiFi QR code work?

Phones read a special WIFI: string encoded in the QR code. When scanned, the phone offers to join that network automatically.

Is it safe to share my WiFi QR code?

The SSID and password are embedded in the QR image itself, so anyone who scans it can join. Do not post it publicly if the network is private.

Can I make a QR code for an open network?

Yes — choose “Open (no password)” and leave the password field empty.
